d: We are looking for a hands-on Oracle OIM / OID Administrator to support and evolve the Oracle Identity and Access Management platform. The role centers on the upgrade of Oracle Identity Manager and Oracle Internet Directory from 11g to 12c, and on the integrations that depend on them, chiefly Oracle E-Business Suite and Oracle Hyperion.

The ideal candidate has personally carried out at least two OIM 11g to 12c upgrade and has delivered EBS and Hyperion integrations in production. This is a delivery role, not an architecture-only role: strong hands-on skills are essential.

Plan and execute OIM 11g R2 PS3 to OIG 12c (12.2.1.3 / 12.2.1.4) upgrades end to end: pre-upgrade readiness checks, RCU schema upgrade, Upgrade Assistant, reconfiguration of domains and post-upgrade validation.
Plan and execute OID 11g (11.1.1.9) to OID 12c (12.2.1.4) upgrades, including schema upgrade, DIP migration and verification of replication and directory integrity.
Decide on in-place vs. out-of-place upgrade approach, prepare rollback plans and run upgrade rehearsals in lower environments before production cut-over.
Migrate and re-test customizations during upgrade: custom connectors, adapters, event handlers, scheduled tasks, plugins, SOA composites and UI/sandbox customizations.
Upgrade connectors (EBS, LDAP/OID, DB, Flat File) to 12c-compatible ICF versions and resolve reconciliation and provisioning regressions.
Apply bundle patches and PSUs to OIG, OID, SOA, WebLogic and OHS using OPatch, and maintain environment parity across Dev, Golden, Staging, Production and DR.
Administer WebLogic domains, managed servers, clusters, Node Manager and Enterprise Manager; perform health checks, performance tuning and capacity planning.

Design and configure identity lifecycle: trusted reconciliation, joiner/mover/leaver, self-registration and sponsored registration, provisioning and de-provisioning, role lifecycle and access policies.
Install, configure and administer OID 11g/12c, including instances, replication (multi-master / fan-out), ACIs and password policies.
Configure and manage Directory Integration Platform (DIP) synchronization and provisioning profiles, including OID–EBS provisioning and AD/OID synchronization.
Perform LDIF-based data migration, bulk loads and schema extensions; monitor and tune OID performance.
Integrate OID with OIM (LDAP/OID connector) and OAM as the identity store.
Configure and support the OIM EBS connectors (EBS User Management and EBS HRMS/Employee Reconciliation) for user and person/position provisioning.
Implement EBS provisioning covering both Person/Position in EBS HRMS and FND User provisioning with responsibilities.
Support EBS SSO through OAM WebGate and EBS AccessGate , and maintain OID–EBS integration (DIP provisioning profiles, user linking).
Troubleshoot reconciliation, responsibility assignment and SSO issues jointly with the EBS DBA and functional teams.
Integrate Hyperion / EPM Shared Services with OID (or AD) as an external user directory provider.
Support Hyperion SSO through OAM/OHS and resolve user, group and provisioning issues with the EPM team.
Integrate OIG, OID/OUD and OAM for end-to-end user management and single sign-on.
Deployment of OAM plugins and configuration of authentication modules and schemes.
Configure MFA (Email / OTP), SSO with third-party IdPs and single logout in OAM.
Configure reverse proxy rules on OHS and deploy WebGates.
Support integrations with Oracle Analytics, Paradiso LMS and ManageEngine SDP.
Provide L1/L2 (and L3 escalation) support; analyse OIM, OID, SOA and WebLogic logs to resolve incidents.
Ensure the IAM implementation meets Oman regulatory requirements and standards such as ISO 27001, and support security assessments and audits.
Produce and maintain upgrade runbooks, playbooks, configuration guides and operational documentation.
Work with architects and the client to gather requirements, run workshops and hand over knowledge to client teams.
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology or a related field.
At least 5+ years of relevant experience in Oracle IAM, with hands-on OIM/OIG and OID administration and development .
Has personally delivered at least one OIM 11g to 12c upgrade (and ideally an OID 11g to 12c upgrade) through to production.
Strong hands-on experience with OID administration, replication and DIP.
Proven delivery of Oracle EBS integration with OIM (EBS UM / HRMS connectors) and OID/AccessGate for SSO.
Hands-on experience integrating Oracle Hyperion / EPM Shared Services with OID/OIM.
Hands-on adapter customization in Design Console, plus event handlers, scheduled tasks and connector customization.
Proficient in Java, SQL/PLSQL and Linux shell scripting; working knowledge of SOA composites.
Strong WebLogic administration: domains, clustering, Node Manager, Enterprise Manager, OPatch.

We are seeking a highly skilled Technical Mechanical Engineer for Mega High-Rise buildings project in Riyadh.

Strong understanding of ASHRAE, NFPA, IPC, and relevant engineering standards.
Familiarity with energy-efficient building solutions and sustainable design practices.
